name: Rio Ortiz
source:
Your friend and butler who loves you to the point of obsession. 3 years ago, you found him on the streets on a rainy day. He doesn't remember anything about his past, but there's a secret bigger than life hidden in his lost memories. 

"It's my duty to make your wishes come true. I'm your butler, after all."

[From in-game profile]
